_childDocuments_.review: I have to confess that BattleRoyale is not my favorite style of play, at the time a few years ago when this was at its height I ignored most of them, so conscientiously I downloaded this game not knowing it was BattleRoyale, I thought it was a simple one game with story mode or PvE/PvP.As soon as I enter the game it asks me to create an account and register an email to link with it, so I was a little suspicious about this, but if you are also suspicious, just register with an alternative email that you create for these types of things. As soon as I log into the game to play, i have to play the tutorial, to my surprise, when i finished the tutorial there was some kind of bug that made me do the tutorial again. Here's a little complaint, I know tutorials are important but, it should be optional. But it's ok. So my first few minutes in this game were not happy at all, I'll tell you why.1. The queue to start a match takes a long time.2. The game is poorly optimized graphically.If you have an older generation PC (2010s) and if your GPU is inferior there are 900 series, it will be bad to play that. It's not impossible, but graphically it won't be worth it. If you have a suitable PC, with at least the minimum requirements being required, you just need to set the resolution of your monitor and it will play fine, but the game is still poorly optimized.It's a good game and fun to play, because I liked it's your gameplay. The moving is fast without having to walk for long miles like the other BR games. You choose a class, see the powers and enter the match, scale buildings, heals through civilians and hunt other players. I wish I could play more, but unfortunately my PC can't handle it, because with the graphics on low and with bad resolution, it's hard to see well.Well, if you're wondering if it's worth downloading and playing, I say it's worth it, it has approximately a size of 20gb and the download is 17gb. _childDocuments_.review: Game is just a generic Third Person Battle Royale with a Vampire theme.Has some cool gameplay mechanics but not innovative or polished enough to make this stand out from other Battle Royales.You will be delighted to know the game has a battle pass with microtransactions and a cash shop.(It's free to play so has to make money somehow)Coming from a new studio with industry veterans seems kind of lazy and unpolished.For starters the game runs like absolute garbage 50-90 is just unacceptable on low settings with an i7-8700k and an RTX 3070 (DX11) The gameplay is very fast and having your frame rate dip for no apparent reason makes the game feel disgusting. Switched the game to (DX12) also the same performance.Movement is very fast but unpolished as you seem to get stuck on almost everything especially when running across roof tops and jumping around. Almost as if when play testing the movement it hasn't been tested extensively and the map hasn't been designed around the movement. This leads to a lot of frustrating fights especially when multiple teams are involved, that coupled with framerate issues... Sucks.The map itself seems to be just tall buildings and long flat roads the only height variation you have is the buildings being taller than other buildings. There are a few locations on the map with different terrain height but they seem to be on the outskirts of the map everything is just long streets, long alleys and tall buildings. a lot of the rooftop designs haven't been tested with the movement mechanics so you end up getting stuck or having your character bug out.Loot is tiered by colour rarity which is always a terrible sign in a Battle Royale game.Balance of weapons seems very mixed but would need more time to test and I'm not doing that with the games performance issues.It's free to play so you can obviously try it yourself and see but game peaked at 20k players and has dwindled since possibly another DOA Battle Royale game that Hyperscaped itself because it's hasn't got anything to make it stand out other than the Vampire theme... Although the more I think about it this is does feel like a Third Person Vampire Hyperscape.

_childDocuments_.review: The entire concept of the game overall is great honestly. They add new things constantly especially quests which just adds more content to the backstory which I love. However, the game severely lacks a way to report other players which is a massive drawback imo. I say this because I come across a lot of people who "cheat" whether it be aim bot or otherwise. I suck at the game I am not gonna lie but I know the difference between me getting bested and being cheated. The controls are also a bit sluggish, and other players have an extremely unfair advantage, those who got to play in the beta test before the official release have more experience and have been able to get used to the game whereas newbies, such as myself, are still trying to learn even after doing the tutorials, I have done them at least 3 times. That being said, the game also lacks skill based matchmaking which imo is a much needed additive, The surroundings of the environment also make it difficult, imo, to be able to detect other players or figure out where you are being shot at from. There is too much going on at once all the time as well. It's often extremely hard to catch your breath in between one fight to the next. The AI, also called Entity Soldiers, are way too overpowered in their arsenals and if you manage to kill them all then as soon as you start trying to loot their weapons and ammo, you have at least 3 other players in your face immediately because they will sit back and watch you do all the work and once you're done they instantly drop in on you while you are most woefully unprepared. The game over all has the potential to be amazing, but I feel like these issues are holding the game's potential back a lot. Just my opinion

_childDocuments_.review: I think the best way to put this game in its place is by redirecting you to the results of a survey the developers did make, or rather the developers own words on the subject.I also think the second best way to put the game in its place is to give my very limited understanding of the game. Quite simply, i like it, it is a really fresh BR game with unique mechanics, it has more emphasis on verticality and movement than many other games in the genre, without making sacrifices to the believability of the games setting. I feel like the biggest issues with the current game are not really in the hands of the developers, but rather a result of a highly competetive market, where this game simply doesn't get enough time on the surface to fully profit from a proper foundation to build a game upon, that is precisely where me making this review comes into play. I want you to try this game and see for yourself. I want you to keep two questions in mind when doing so: "are the issues i am experiencing because of the game being bad, or because of factors the developers can't really influence?" and "if these issues did not exist, would this be a game i would want to see more of?" My answer to both of these questions are given by what i have written before. I think this game has its place, but the Battle Royale market is extremely oversaturated, lowering the chances of this game succeeding for no issues by the game itself.If you read what i have linked to you, you will see the developers are humble and honest about their progress. They are sharing their reception of the issues, which is largely correct. They are honest when adressing how they will attempt to face the issues. The in-game monetization is extremely fair and all you can really question in their motive is if it was a good call to make a Battle Royale game in the first place, but applying that logic would be to actively deny innovation in known genres.

_childDocuments_.review: So, 12.6 hours current at the time of this review. (UPDATE FOR 4/5/2022 PATCH FIX AT BOTTOM)For those who don't want to read a long winded review about the different aspects of the game read this.The game itself is great, fits right into the vampire genre and has its own place in the BR Genre, BUT at the time of this review, Trios are almost always a duo without a 3rd friend, there are hitreg issues, causing you to do hundreds of damage and the enemy not dying, and there are a slow growing number of hackers.Now for those who don't mind reading a review from a typical gamer.So gun play is pretty good, it's kinda like fortnite with the weapons and rarities. Green bad Gold Gud. Basically from what I can tell, ammo, accuracy, and possibly even damage is increased with each level of rarity, ammo and accuracy for sure, damage im not so sure. It pushes the player to either use what they have to their advantage or roam around the quite big map looking for better loot and avoiding enemy players, NPCs and the red gas. Guns in this game are pretty basic: AK, Marksman Rifle, Pump Shotgun, Double Barrel, Revolver, Sniper, Silenced SMG, Tommy Gun, LMG, Toggler, Pistol, Dual Pistols, Minigun, Burst Rifle, Crossbow, Heavy Crossbow, Dual Crossbows and 9-Barrel. I may have missed one or two out, but the meta seems to be the AK, DB, Minigun or the Toggler, as these seem to have the best range, accuracy, damage, or ammo count, AK and DB can be purple (Havent seen gold yet), Minigun is gold already and Toggler can be Gold too. NPCs drop burst rifles when killed, yet the guns don't do as much damage as the NPCs themselves, and also don't come with the laser sights. If you go into a high tier loot area, be weary of the NPCs because they will shred your armour and health.In Bloodhunt we have a feature called "Blood Resonance", humans around the map have different emotional factors, so in Bloodhunt, Sanguine (Passive Healing), Choleric (Melee Damage Boost), Melancholic (Q Ability (Archetype Skill specific to your character) recharge decrease), Phlegmatic (E Ability (Clan Skill, specific to your clan) recharge decrease), Potent (Grants an extra life, can't be higher than 1), and normal humans which just refill your HP. Each of these resonance can stack up to 3. Each individual resonance maxed can be: Health regen at 4hp a second, Melee damage can get buffed by another 50%, recharge for both skills decreased by 50%. Have a total of 3 resonance for a specific blood type does not stack, so the max amounts of buffs are as I listed.I spoke about gun play, so now Melee. Melee is somewhat of a meta in this game, Katanas and Scourge Blades (I think thats what they're called) aren't too hard to get and arguably are the best Melee in the game, being purple rarity. Katanas have an ability to deflect bullets back at the enemies, and Scourge Blades can dash into an enemy causing decent damage. Now, the issue I have with Melee in this game is that they do decent damage as a base, with Choleric, 50% more damage, you can basically 2-3 hit enemies with full HP and armour (200HP 50 Armour). Now that seems a little OP to me as the only counter is up close with a Double Barrel, which is a bit stupid considering you only have two shots, sure the damage may down them, but if it's Trio, youve got 2 others to deal with.Matchmaking. At the time of this review, there is only Solo and Trio matchmaking. I play exclusively with one friend because we can't find a 3rd to download this game and 90% of the time we NEVER have a random stay in our party. When we do they often ignore us, don't spawn with us, or just throw the game, die immediately and spam pings on the nearest revive. This makes the majority of the Trio matches I play especially hard as you either have a 3rd teammate leave before the game starts, doesn't communicate, or just doesn't want to play properly and ruins it for the rest of us. The game desperately needs a Duo mode, or at least the ability to choose whether or not to fill during a queue, or both. Current bugs that are pretty much game breaking at the time of this review. Hitreg, the amount of games I have went into and have dealt so much damage to a player, more than the 250 they have, they just wont die. This isn't a trash aim or get gud thing either, A LOT of people are noticing this issue more and more and it's driving people away. Climbing is somewhat of an issue at the moment as sometimes you will get thrown off the building toward the top or just get stuck because the roofs stick out. Servers are also somewhat annoying, you'll get times where you'll just lag for absolutely no reason, but it's genuinely just the servers, I don't know why but hopefully they fix all of these issues.Honestly, I'd recommend it if you wanna have fun, but it's just getting to a point where everyone plays the exact same way and there is hardly any fun in using the same build as everyone else. I like the game because it's vampires, there are different clans and different abilities, but they don't get used uniquely or to benefit the team, players I encounter almost always separate when seeing an enemy and pretty much just spam an ability until you die. When I first started playing there was a lot of players using tactics and being team players, but if I'm honest it's just Melee Abusers and team splitters. Hopefully the game improves over time but I feel like it's heading in the direction of Warzone with set guns and items being the meta and no one really has an individual play-style.UPDATE:Yeah so after my review, I played the game more and it just got more frustrating, Trios being 2v3s, melee abusers, just everything bad i spoke about. But today the patch came out and me and my friend tried playing it again for just under 2 hours and my god is it worse. Every game I went into it lagged like hell, and it was not my internet. Every match has packet loss, bad server performance, and somehow has issues with my refresh rate, which is 144 or 165, but shouldnt matter since my fps is 180-200. The issue with not dealing damage seems to be even worse, and the hitreg issue still hasnt been fixed, and is somewhat worse with some melee weapons. But on top of that, I get all the issues but players outside of the highest render/view distance can laser me and get me to low health or down me easily when i can't even see their player while im looking at the direction of their bullets. This game needs a more solid AntiCheat, and needs to be fixed, the fact it has a battle pass before the major issues have even been fixed is a joke. I've uninstalled the game and won't be playing it unless these gamebreaking issues are fixed, and I recommend those who see this also do the same, because you can deal so much damage to a player just for it not to count, hackers cross mapping you, which also you cant even report in trios, they make you do it through their webpage, which is pointless as how are you supposed to get the name if you play with streamer mode enabled like myself??? Also their discord server has a trend going where if you have above a set percentage of accuracy (according to trackergg) you are cheating or hacking. because apparently you cant be accurate in this game...UPDATE 2:A battle royale that has RANKED before the damage and hitreg has been fixed is an absolute joke, so basically no matter how accurate you are or how good you may be, it's a matter of luck if you die first or the enemy dies first from your shots.

_childDocuments_.review: This game is the best BR. The setting is different from most other games, taking place in gothic Prague. The other main difference being that this game has way more verticality to it, you are able to climb buildings or slide down the walls, wall jump and then link those moves to create a very agile and fast battle, making other games of the same genre seem slow in comparison, besides each class has different abilities some of them being mobility skills that can be linked with the standard move set to keep you on the move and the enemies guessing where the bullets and hits are coming from. If you defeat an opponent they will be crawling, after a certain time they can come recover, or you can finish them off either with your weapons and skills or by diablerizing them, basically drinking their blood which gives you a passive buff.The character customization is so cool and stylish, there are many options when it comes to clothes, masks and even piercings and tattoos. That I always have a hard time trying to choose what I will be wearing for the net battle, specially cause each class counts as a different character, so you can customize them all differently and each one has also exclusive clothes that fit their background.While the developer messed up on release by letting some bugs live for too long, those bugs have been fixed and the game is so much fun to play. If you are looking for a very action oriented game, this is for you! You won't be disappointed.

_childDocuments_.review: I've played several battle royales and this one feels the best. Warzone feels like call of duty but with extra steps, and call of duty is trash these days so imagine trash++. Apex has classes BUT there's so much running and not enough action, and don't get me started on any customization's in that game, it's tremendously horrible.... Fortnite, not going to waste my breath and you shouldn't either. PUBG has NOTHING special about it. Realm Royale took longer than forever without any action, but that game doesn't exist anymore. POE: Royale, you won't find a game. Nuclear Winter, felt like Fortnite but garbage, and see how I felt about Fortnite earlier. Super Animal Royale, while it's a fun game, it gets very boring, very quickly. This game takes away most of those problems.So, I like playing this game and here's why you might or might not.Pros:(+) hot vampires, and you get to drink their blood... if you're into that sort of thing ;)(+) great, fluid movement(+) weapons feel good, each one feels like it can perform just as well as the other(+) classes are unique, and feel like I'm playing different styles with each one(+) the randoms that were good, stuck around, and won with, I've befriended. Can't get any of my friends to play with me, so it's nice making some along the way. [BUT see cons section about randoms as well](+) relatively grind-able player icons+banners [free as well might I add]. Remember Modern Warfare 2, where you could earn and display your feats/achievements for others to see in your icons/banners? This is exactly that. 10 kills in a match? Here's an icon. Drained 100 players? Here's a banner. I'm so glad to see someone do this again.(+) there's action around every corner, especially in solo play.(+) free, so you can keep your money in the [blood] bank.(+) hasn't gotten boring yet [currently at 19.8 hours] Cons:(-) melee weapons coupled with 50% extra melee damage is unbearable to play against, but doesn't happen a lot(-) sometimes shooting people just doesn't hit them. Maybe it's my connection, maybe it's theirs, or maybe it's the games(-) randoms feel incompetent a majority of the time, even when they're a duo. [this isn't an issue when you play solo] [PLEASE do the tutorial first](-) sometime's when you really need a gun or weapon, it's just ammo and healing.(-) never been to a party? Never been invited to a party? Well now's your chance since there's third parties all over and they all come to you. (-) certain enhancements [reduced cooldowns, ->health over time<-, increased melee damage] feel mandatory which means I can't get the others a chunk of the time. AND the biggest con of all (-) they ramped up production of this instead of Bloodlines 2. Set to be another great vampire RPG game, they were working on it for a while and then made this game happen. Look at Titanfall 1/2 and Apex legends. It will be FOREVER [if at all] till we get to see a Titanfall 3 because of the ''''success'''' [>insert eyeroll] of Apex Legends. And I loved Titanfall 2, and I really hope that this game and Bloodlines 2 doesn't do the exact same thing as them and put the game in the 'coffin'. Rant aside, I think this game is actually pretty good as a fast [sometimes moderately] paced shooter and I think that the pros vastly outweigh the cons. I think that this is different than the other battle royales like I mentioned at the beginning and that you should give it a chance just like I did. You might just have a 'fang'-tastic time :)TLDR: This game takes a 'bite' right out of the competition and put's them all in their 'coffins'. Now is the age of the vampire and you should 'turn' to the winning side and join us as we rise from our eternal slumber with this great game.

_childDocuments_.review: The vast majority of the negative reviews are people who are whining because this is a Battle Royale -OR- because this isn't a masterpiece immersive sim in the vein (heh) of Bloodlines.First Impressions:- Prague is gorgeous.- Each of the three clans currently available (Brujah, Nosferatu, Toreador) are distinctive, interesting, and fun.- There's extensive cosmetic customization that is beautifully designed and thus far, it feels rewarding to customize each archetype.- There's a ton of well-written lore, and there seems to be a story that will unfold over time and presumably extend when new maps and/or clans are released.- A few small UI glitches, but nothing game-breaking.- Weapons seem to be well-balanced, but melee doesn't seem viable thus far.- I suck (ha) at this game.Monetization:- There's a 100 tier Battle Pass (for only $10) currently available. (Focus seems to be on Toreador this season.)- There's a needlessly expensive "Flash Shop" for limited-time cosmetic items that I'll never touch.TL;DR - It's a Vampire: the Masquerade game, and it's free. Play it.

_childDocuments_.review: Awful game.It's a terrible experience. Devs mostly care about money, microtransactions are already implemented, there is a store already running as well as mechanics that encourage you to buy ♥♥♥♥, unfortunately the game itself is not even finished enough for early access, the most crucial things are not there and already existing things are very poorly implemented.Lobby system is garbage, you just stand in place for a mach, that's all. Terrible idea and a waste of time.Map lading, character and spawnpoint selection are all very poorly done and make the game feel very clunky.The whole game is just run and gun except you spend 90% of the time waiting to get into a match.  It takes a lot of time to start playing and when you finally get  to play you die in 3 shots and you go back to the waiting for a match.Before the match starts you have to wait when picking the character and a spawn point, which all can be done when people are waiting for matchmaking, you can already pick your character in the menu, so why bother? I use random spawn most of the time, it doesn't matter where you spawn, everything is basically the same.Movement is really slow, I was expecting to move a bit faster than a fast jog, especially considering the superpowers you get. Jumping and wall climbing is slow and kid of wacky. Sliding is interesting but rarely works the way I would like it to, I often don't run fast enough and just stop and crouch, other times I slide across out of my cover and fall of the building because I tried to hide behind a chimney. It's quite annoying because you need to slide in order to do the "power jump" so you do it a lot. While running on the roofs you can't really get any flow and you can't jump far enough to clear the gap between buildings, even a small one.Aiming is garbage, your effective rage is so small you have to fight at close rage. Shooting sucks, there are no head shots implemented, which is weird af. Enemies you shoot feel like damn sponges, you just keep shootn' and they keep runin'. For some reason you die instantly every time. I guess that is because you have no chance to actually practice shooting, there is no place to do it, when you try to do it in game people will just run to you and kill you, even if you get to a very far away place on the edge of the map.You can't switch shoulders so you can peek easily on the right but the left side is almost not possible.In this game exists the dumbest mechanic, after you die you get "downed" which means you just lay there like a bag of potatoes and crawl around hoping person that killed you will forget about that and after 5 years you will be able to get back up. Also you can't do ♥♥♥♥ while downed, except for muse, that class can use abilities but they take a whole decade to recharge, so when you use it to engage or try to escape you are just a regular potato sack like everyone else. Personally I just leave the mach after I get downed because 99,999% of the time I will just die shortly after, except for few rare occasions when person that killed me got killed and the other one didn't notice me. In general a very bad mechanic, players should be able to do stuff when downed.Getting weapons is really easy, there is too many of them everywhere. Abilities take a long time to recharge, and they are not that useful because guns are plenty enough to kill someone. What that results in is PUBG in Prague. After seeing the trailer I was expecting a lot more ability usage. I guess devs decided that wasn't a good idea after all.Another reason this game pissed me off is the absolute eternity you have to endure in order to join another mach. There is literally just one ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ map, load that thing on startup and done, no need to load the same ♥♥♥♥ every single ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ time. If someone is playing on a potato everyone has to wait for them to load the whole thing. C'mon, it's not that hard to fix and should be ready on day one. I know you want people to visit the store and buy ♥♥♥♥ but that is just another reason for them to leave and never come back. Besides, there are just 4 items in the store. Like really? You want to milk players but don't even give them anything to spend money on. Those card and challenge screens after you die are crap as well.There's also a weird premium advert after you die, you are shown an item you can get after you level up but you actually need to pay to get it.One more thing, there are a lot of hackers everywhere, so winning is not an option. I was placed 6th at best.The whole game feels rushed and unplanned, or just very badly planned.I was expecting a fast paced game with  a lot of cool vampire abilities but in the end it's just another garbage battle royale.

_childDocuments_.review: It is sad how much potential this game has and how the developers squandered it.Bugs, horrible matchmaking, long queues,.. in there is a really good game, and hopefully one day it will be brought out, but at this point I cannot recommend you enough... to stay away from it.______________________________________________________________I did read your forum post, as that was what brought me to the point of writing the review.The core issues I see with the game at this point are matchmaking and the slow speed at which you deploy hotfixes to bugs.Especially the former is for me why I don't think this game will survive a year, or at least not without slipping below 100 concurrent players.I started playing Bloodhunt after I came home from TwitchCon Amsterdam, and - please correct me if I'm wrong/missed anything - I don't think I recall a single patch since. Meanwhile I observed a number of bugs, which I looked online for get arounds and where at this point clearly well known, the most common one probably the resetting player card.The other issue - matchmaking - is something I must say I am confused by how we ended up with it.I remember distinctly that the most fun I had with the game were the first few games when there were bots mixed in, which while easy to kill still gave you that bit of an endorphin boost. Not to mention significantly shorter queue times.After I "ran out" of games with bots my experience with the game shifted drastically - for the worse: I kept getting matched against players who were significantly above my skill level and matchmaking took ages. This combined often meant that I waited longer to play a match than I actually was playing said match.In terms of balance and game design - a far less prominent point IMHO, I think the saboteur class should be reworked, considering how everything about it promotes what I'd refer to as "toxic gameplay" - as in "creating frustration for others" - such as sitting in bushes or hiding in corners just to ambush player and running away on the low ground through tunnels while dropping mines. Also it would be generally nice if player models at longer distances would be more prominent, as otherwise basically you play at a disadvantage if you use any customization that makes it easier to spot you, such as magenta hair or colourful, reflective coats.

_childDocuments_.review: A decent shooter that reminds me of the old days of Gunz The Duel yet this game seems to suffer from the same problems and a few extra. While a somewhat solid game it does need some tweaking here and there, though I have heard the devs have pretty much abandoned the game.First and foremost is the matchmaking system, you'll be lumped in with players of higher (VERY HIGH) level and skill making the matches one sided requiring multiple re-queues just to get a chance at how to play. I'd suggest starting team death matches until one can get a handle on the weapon and power basics.Second are the game modes with Bloodhunt being the main one where you have to complete a majority of your quests. I really feel that there needs to be a PvE or a non player instance where the quests can get done separately without the hassle of being gunned down by other players. It's the masquerade for crying out loud, there needs to be a bit more political knife and dagger stuff going on too. Queue timers can be long which makes waiting to get back into a game a bit of a drag.Most of your "Quests" will require you to play Bloodhunt matches with no indication of where you are supposed to go, the "investigate the crash site" for example. I have searched the entire area in many matches to the point of exposing myself to other players and still haven't been able to complete it. I'm not saying we need quest markers everywhere, but a little hint of what direction to go in would be useful.Lastly, there are some instances you'll encounter players with aimbots or the a third party method of revealing your location on the map, report these players as soon as you encounter them. If you can get past most of this you'll have a good time, best played with a friend for maximum laughs.

_childDocuments_.review: Dienekes_SM [developer] Posted: Sep 18 @ 9:54amHello,We felt obligated to post this statement on this review because it isn’t really about the game itself, and the spyware claim is blatantly false. This has been demonstrated in many articles already. Not only is it false, but it is also damaging to our first game, Bloodhunt, and our studio Sharkmob. By posting these types of unfounded reviews, you are potentially putting in jeopardy the work of more than 150 people who poured their sweat and blood into making Bloodhunt the game we are proud to call our first baby.The allegation of Bloodhunts anti-cheat software being spyware surfaced a few days ago - and it is simply false. The rumor started after a community member discovered that the anti-cheat application was sometimes running for a short while after the game was shut down (for up to 90 seconds). A few files were also left on the hard-drive after uninstall of the game. These two problems were connected and classified as bugs by the development team. They have both been fixed and patched since.The anti-cheat in the game is just that, an anti-cheat. This has also been confirmed by the community member who discovered the issue. We only collect data related to Bloodhunt and we do not share that data with anyone unrelated to the operation of the game. Bloodhunt uses an anti-cheat that operates on the kernel level of your PC, at the core of the computers operating system. It does this because cheats often operate on that level too and so any counter-measure needs to be on the same level. This is true for most anti-cheat software out there.Cheating in multiplayer games is sadly rampant today and many major online games use kernel level anti-cheat to protect the players form abuse. Bloodhunt has been in Early Access for just over a week now and we will continue to optimize systems, adapt to how cheaters are trying to abuse the game and develop Bloodhunt together with the community.Best regards// The Sharkmob teamI really think this game deserved to be more than it is. Dont give up devs and continue to make more projects!

Frankly i believe that removing the ability to kill people with firearms and making it required to use the execution to actually kill a player is necessary to make this BR actually stand out as well as keep it lore friendly to what the world of darkness actually is. Lowering firearm damage is also what i believe needs to happen as the map is already poorly laid out for many killboxes, as well as the TTK is insanely quick compared to more popular BR'S. The match time does not need to be rapid pace as already we have matches with 60 people compared to the usual 100+.

_childDocuments_.review: So It's a BR (Battle Royal) personally I'm not a fan of BR, but  one it's free and two I've always been a fan of the Vampire The Masquerade universe. At the time of writing this the battle pass was free, so a lot of the issues I have with BR are not an issue, but the game as a whole is extremely lacking as far as longevity. Once I completed the "Battle Pass" I kinda lost interest. There is a kind of fetch stuff like story that you accomplish while trying to compete in the BR matches which is just more of a nuisance then it is fun. In all honesty there is a perfect opportunity for a GTA or RDR online like experience which is more disappointing than anything, because even though there seems to still be developer support at the time of writing this due to there being activity on the Twitter page, I don't see them taking that path.My favorite part is the Team Deathmatch, but again seems to be lacking. While most of the time I prefer Bots in games, they can be pretty useless. Another big irritant is how Classes are handled when playing with other players, if you get put on a team with other players than only one person per three person team can be any one specific class. So the game forces you to play as another class which wouldn't be a huge deal, but that means you need to be prepared to use a minimum of three different classes at the drop of a hat.There's plenty of room for improvement, but there's also alot of solid gamplay. Once you get past the BR gameplay mechanics It's an awesome game, I just wish there was more.

_childDocuments_.review: I am a Boomer and I have played too many games and still do.I played the old masquerade games at its current and BF1942 and many other games ever since.This game has more potential than some AAA games that released this and last year.Many AAA games that releases has some optimization issues and are usually past early access and $40+ and you still dump money in them afterwards. - So here is to the new generation of gamers expecting a perfect game compared to what they are already bored of (COD, Fortnite, Other games that are AAA but fall off cause of these gamers)So here are some cons.. but ask yourself, "when are there not cons with an EARLY ACCESS GAME?"Especially a free one, it is to be expected some errors. I guess I like to look past some of the things that can be fixed and worry about the other stuff.____ My Top 3 The Cons____"most helpful to fix for masses"____*Poor Optimization* - My PC barley has issues running this game, there are some system spikes for sure, the majority of players might have these issues - but the devs are already working on that, shortly after release they saw the issues going on and released a statement for a near patch to help with some of these issues - as well as giving instructions on how to uninstall said anticheat (Maybe they will get a better anti-cheat soon)  - yet still negative reviews without reading said notes - This is something that can be fixed by the devs -Settings UI/Character Customization/Selection UI:  It feels clunky and chunky texts and hover selections - we understand they went for the Goth/Vampire theme but I personally think its too RED BRIGHT (the settings screen) and should be a Darker Reddish Tone, and the Font cleaner. (especially Graphics Settings) more cleaner to be able to stare at - at longer times.Gunplay & The Interacting Environment/AI - The shooting feels like APB or something, not very EXCITING shooting play - Using abilities are more fun - I think they could work on this to be a little better and cleaner. More fluid, more animations, or multiple animations depending what position you came from when Drinking Bloooood or wall climbing. Just ... more.. Variety could surely be used in animating + content added/rearranged - Working on how abilities are synced with guns/fighting should be more looked into3 solid cons that the devs can work on to make this game more playable for the masses.______________________________________________The Pros: Here we goes!Movement/Maneuverability: I really enjoy the sliding. They should allow a longer leap after slide jumping off a roof or in general. What if they added to Jump Off Walls onto other walls near you while regular running? That would be sick too.Its fluid and nice and theyve done a great job with this and the animations.I do feel we could use more emotion or intensity in some sense when drinking blood from humans, but its still fun to do. And should allow Partial drinking so you can at least get 50% or 100% human consumption.. or at least make them look like theyre in pain.. Its not fun when you risk your life for more blood and theyre not even enjoying the kiss of Death!?Level design and character design is great in the game for its early stage - I totally feel like I am in a secret vamp society.Battle Royal Concept is unique and something different - a different way to survive and be on top of the matchThis game can feel like hyperscape or fortnite with all the roof running - More UNIQUE Map design and like Transylvania small arena mode should be added.Variety of Classes and abilities to sync with your team mates and play style is well done and well thought _____________Many of the things stated can and should be fixed in due time.. I see the potential, I enjoyed the game for more than a  few rounds. Maybe it is me that just wants to see this game gets better reviews than it deserves, but there is a high expectation these days for games, and people shouldnt expect that from every game that isnt even $60. Go do that for Call of duty.Devs - Please fix the play-ability issues for the masses and also the Loading Screen/sync - and we are sure begin to easily understand the potential you have put out in front of us..  Until then - we have some work to do - but what a game to start off with and get the ball rolling on - Vampire Battle Royal, baby!

_childDocuments_.review: This has the potential to be one of the best battle royale games on the market. It has unique ability's that make all characters stand out and getting good at any of them is worthwhile. The guns all feel good and can kill, even the starting pistol. Melee combat is extremely worthwhile compared to any other BR. Instead of the tried and true same feeling of running across a horizontal map the game is near 50/50 on vertical climbs and wall jumps as well as running on flat surfaces. So how does an edgy setting with great mechanics fail in a saturated market that needed a breath of fresh air? Well by having an incompetent dev team with no experience in a BR till this game. This brand new studio has absolutely no urgency on updates or bug fixes. The hackers run amok with only one wipe on accounts to date at nearly 2 months into the games launch. Only 900 accounts were taken out on a FREE to play game. I can almost promise without a shadow of a doubt every single one of those hackers already had two or three alt accounts ready so it was all face value and no substance. The game started with a ranked solo mode that after two weeks was taken out and still not reinstated because they have no fix for the hackers that are already near platinum rank keeping actual players down. It was also not rank based so plats could face off against brand new bronze ranks. No room to grow against people of your own skill whatsoever. The newest character enforcer has a 3 second invincibility shield as its ability. That sounds like not a big deal on paper but with how much damage a shotgun can do those three seconds to close the gap on another player means an almost certain kill from point blank. The only patch they've done since launch covered about half the known bugs and the most important one was not fixed. The bug has been nicknamed the "reload bug". Sometimes you'll go to reload the gun and finish the animation and go to shoot only to find you still have no bullets. That alone could get you killed if you charged in thinking you were ready. If it wasn't bad enough most of the time if you got the bug you'll need to reload 2 more times after for it count. The way these devs described it in the patch notes was "A multi headed hydra". If that doesn't install confidence I don't know what could. This game really does feel fun. I have spent a lot of time and money in this game. _childDocuments_.review: this is the BR ive been the most hooked on out of all the ones ive played. the vampire themeing is definitely part of that, i love vampires and the vtm world is very cool, and the game does a great job of translating stuff from lore into game mechanics. but the gameplay itself is just so smooth, the movement combined with the awesome urban, vertical, gigantic level adds a very unique touch. the gunplay itself is fine, but combined with the powers and the ability to climb walls and zip around the map makes it really addictive and it feels like the skill ceiling is high enough to be interesting.i also really like some of the streamlining of the BR elements, for example i dont need to really ever worry about inventory space. every individual item has its own slot with its own capacity limit. so other than guns/melee, if i see something i want i can just run over it to auto-grab it without having to worry about inventory. weapons have rarities but there aren't attachments for them or anything like that. it means i don't have to focus too much on my inventory/menuing and what im looting, and can handle all that stuff on the fly. which is good, because everything is super fast paced in the game.the map is probably the single greatest strength of the game, there are 0 open spaces, theres cover everywhere, sometimes you want to be on the side of a building, sometimes the top, sometimes the street, it all depends on whom you are hunting, whom you are running from, and where you want to go. this changes too depending on what archetype (read: class) you play, as ones with stealth are going to play differently than those with movement abilities.its free and they're updating it and at time of review the battlepass is free too. oh i should mention, the fashion is absolutely bonkers and addicting, its all vampire as ♥♥♥♥ and that's what i love to see. almost no normal clothing or makeup or piercings or sunglasses, its all weird ♥♥♥♥ _childDocuments_.review: I love this game, but it needs a ranked mode. A battle royale should always, and I mean ALWAYS prioritize a way for players to keep playing. Because at its core, it is a repetitive game mode. Sharkmob needed to launch this game with a way to keep players "playing". There are no ranked leaderboards to climb on a late Saturday night. There are no ways to view your skill increase over time. To see yourself go from a novice to something you couldn't have ever imagined. Trying to stop the leaking player numbers with a battlepass or new character, although fun and creative, are not real solutions. Players are leaving because there is no reason to stay. So give them a reason, put the game on hold, put all resources into making a fun and addicting ranked system, and the people will come. You guys have something really special here, prowling throughout the late night streets of Prague is something no other game has. Using quick and witty movement to jump from building to building, alongside unique and amazing abilities to out-smart your opponents, is something no other game has. I LOVE this game to death but the fact that there is no ranked mode is insane, and is the reason why I can't recommend it.

_childDocuments_.review: Day 1 - Gameplay = unique battle royale style, spawn in and find weapons and feed on mortals to ready yourself to face off against the other vampires, being able to scale buildings and use vampiric abilities to turn the tide of battle in an instant.Animations = very smooth, very satisfying and alot of blood!Matchmaking = seems to be fairly balanced (example being teamed up with people your level and facing similarly levelled players).Questing = run of the mill, go to this location and find said item, or scout a certain location.Day 2 - Gameplay = hackers and cheaters arrive, anyone with a controller and using cronus will win every fight (cheater example). Aimbotters and wallhackers and GOD moders plague every match, being able to 360 spin whilst hipfiring a minigun and hitting all their shots and tracking you through walls, if you are not dead after they land you will fire 3 magazines into their chest with all hits and they will walk it off (without immunity class skill) (hack example)Animations = people have worked out how to double jump by glitching animations together.people have worked out how to glitch into plant pots and sides of buildings to avoid hit box detection, so they can revive and wipe you out because you couldnt kill them whilst they were downed.Matchmaking = people were level 20+ by this point and either get teamed up with level 5's - 6's every match and people refuse to learn or follow instruction, say you find a friend to play with and you matchmake, you will not get a 3rd person in your group so you will always be outnumbered in all situations.Questing = After completing a couple of quests you will need to randomly talk to all npc's in the hub (elysium) 2 or 3 times each to find out wether they have a quest to give you or not. (no indicators above their heads etc)Day 3 - Gameplay = Every match is plagued by cheaters and hackers at this point, the map is so small that you will be submerged by 3 groups of hackers and nowhere to hide or run or regroup to even fight back.Animations = people have worked out how to triple cast abilities without cooldown which results in extended immunity to damage and unblockable knockbacks so you cannot even lift your weapons.Matchmaking = unchanged.Questing = unchanced.(this post will be bombarded by people claiming their are 0 cheats on this game and that its all bad skill etc, also from your run of the mill cancerous defenders who dont want you to ruin their advantages in games) as a response to that there has been numerous forum posts on steam advertising working undetectable hacks for the game which have all been deleted within the hour.EDIT REVIEW: 11/02/2023Hacks are out of control, DDOS servers whenever you like. battlepass has gone free because everyone has left the game, let it die.

_childDocuments_.review: As of right now, this game needs massive improvements. When it was first out in early access I had framerate drops to under 60fps on competitive settings with a Ryzen 7 3700X and a RX 6800 (FSR Performance was on too). It made the game extremely hard to play and control. I have now upgraded to a Ryzen 7 5800X and I'm still getting the same exact performance issues. It's like I never even got a better CPU at all, and I know it's not on my end because literally any other game I play runs like a dream. It probably would have been a better experience if I used the DX12 API....if it even worked at all. As of before and even now, when trying to play the game on DX12, it instantly crashes during loading and there doesn't seem to be a fix for this at all yet. I'm extremely disappointed on how performance has barely been improved from the 5 months the game has been offline and how DX12 is still unusable.Controller support has improved which I can give a plus about. A lot of the issues I had for controller binds were fixed and adjusted to make it better for me to actually play without reaching over to press a key on my keyboard cause it's not mapped on Controller. Although it still needs work, it's getting there.Overall, extremely disappointed so far. I feel as though performance would be a huge priority for a game that requires fast paced reflexes and has an overall competitive nature. Yet it really feels like it's at the bottom of the list. Hopefully this changes when full release comes. It's a great concept for a battle royale, however it's constantly being kneecapped by optimization issues and overall stability.

_childDocuments_.review: The game is really fun! Though the gunplay is fairly standard BR play, the verticality and movement options (like each of the clans special movement ability and the climbing up walls) make both exploration and combat much more dynamic than your typical BR. Each of the clan archetypes also brings with it special powers that really add that little bit extra to the combat even though some clan powers need a little bit of reworking to get to their full potential. The atmosphere is also incredible. Most BR games have pretty bland environments with only certain key locations on the map having anything super interesting. In this game the entire map is a city so no matter where you go there are walls to climb, roofs to run across, and hidden nooks and crannies to get through to find weapons/items or to hide in. The city itself, Prague, is also beautifully designed with different parts of the city giving different vibes making the city feel real. This is also enhanced by a pretty well-written index of lore that you slowly uncover as you play more and more of the game. The game also works in the Vampire: The Masquerade feel pretty well for something that seems so drastically different then the tabletop or other VtM games like Bloodlines. Not only is their the previously mentioned lore as well as a few NPCs in the Elysium (the games hub), but also their are a number of NPC civilians around the map that you can feed on either simply to heal or some of them have resonances that you give you special buffs. The healing items of the game are also blood bags, another flavor win. And, of course, the powers each clan has are based on the disciplines from the tabletop game. The game also brings the masquerade from the tabletop, having other players be able to see marked if you use your powers near an mortal NPC or kill them.My main complaint about the game is the battlepass. There's just not enough to get me excited yet. I get having mostly smaller customizations to fill out space, but every big milestone (maybe every ten or twenty levels) should have something really big and drastic and what they have right now just isn't that. Most of the clothes you can get seem pretty similar to each other and the only really unique one is left to the very end of the battle pass. And with the rate at which you get each level, that might take a while (though there have been improvements with that). Of course, if you like player banners, emotes, and tattoos, there is plenty here for you.Other than that, I think the game is really enjoyable and, despite my issues with the battlepass, the customization that is there, even though its only a little, is fun to play around with and you can get some pretty distinct looking characters. It's mostly in the clothes were they start to look samey.Overall, I give this game a positive review, just needs a bit more polish to fix a few relatively minor bugs and the addition of a somewhat more improved level of customization.

_childDocuments_.review: I'm really confused as to what the fuss is about with this title.   I played Bloodhunt for less than one hour, and genuinely feel comfortable saying that I saw all it had to offer - which is not a good thing.  Bloodhunt is extremely bare-bones in terms of almost every design aspect that matters.  It feels like an Early Access game, or a demo.  There are only a handful of weapons, and they're very generic, both in terms of look and feel.  The items (armor, blood packs, etc) are equally generic.  The map you fight on basically has two levels; the streets, and the rooftops.  Almost everything between those two levels is just set dressing.  Can't enter 99% of the buildings, and if you can it's just one room on the first floor.  Your vampire abilities are very low-impact, with escape/movement abilities being the only ones that feel like they have any real impact on the otherwise very basic 'run-n-gun' gameplay.Bloodhunt has some story, but not much.  What exists feels like the notes you'd take in order to start writing the rough draft that might become the basis for your story, and isn't enough to amount to any kind of real narrative.  The vampiric trappings of the game are the only thing with any real thought or effort put in, which is probably great for anyone who enjoys vampire stories/tropes, but to me they just seemed like an excuse for the game to exist, not an actual important feature of the game.  There's just enough of that stuff in Bloodhunt to set up an explanation for the playable classes, and their power sets, but honestly those are also so basic that they could be painted over with any brush you choose.  Bloodhunt could easily be turned in to a game about people who are genetic mutants, sci-fi experiments gone awry, alien symbiotes (you name it) with very little effort.  Makes the game feel like a pitch for a Battle Royale game somebody wanted to be generic enough to pitch to any publisher on the market, with vampires just being a placeholder for "people with super-human abilities."What game does exist plays well, I can't deny that, but the question is "is it worth playing... even for free?"  My answer is a firm "no." The fact that the game functions isn't enough reason to play it, and there isn't much of interest to say about Bloodlines other than that fact.  I need a bit more to get in to a game, beyond "it's a game, and you can play it."

_childDocuments_.review: Now, while "Vampire: The Masquerade" may seem like an interesting concept (kinda), the game itself is terribly un-fun, and buggy. To begin with, the class system doesn't even make a modicum of sense. The two classes that relate to each other share an active, making both of the classes feel generally the same, and uninspired. Sharing a passive or something would have made more sense.The game *feels* alright at first, that is, until you try to do anything that isn't running on the street or standing still. Going anywhere near a building, or any kind of slope sends your character flying, with unrealistic physics. Just because the characters are vampires doesn't mean gravity doesn't affect them, unless I missed that somewhere in every single vampire-related media. Oh! And have you seen a vampire get eaten by a shark after they dip their toes in knee-deep water? Yeah, me neither, but apparently Sharkmob AB has! Because I assume this city just has sharks literally everywhere.And the combat. The combat is unbearable! When you get shot at, you can't even hear from, and aiming while avoiding gunfire is borderline impossible. High ground is the only way to stay alive, and even then, if you clash with another team, have fun figuring out who's who. Trust me, you can't. The bullets sound like pillows, and you can't even tell where they are coming from. And when you finally have the upper hand and a good opening strike, better hope the enemy doesn't have the ability to just negate damage for a couple of seconds!All in all, I give this game a Morbius out of 10. It's unbearably boring, and It's not well made, hidden under the vise of okay graphics. I wouldn't recommend this to anyone, not even as a joke.

_childDocuments_.review: This is a classic Battle Royale without any revolutionary features. You play as a vampire and have different skillset, depending what clan or class you choose. It is obviously based on the Vampire: The Masquerade game and it has some mechanics which requires you to maintain the masquerade. The graphics are really good. Animations are awesome too, it's really fun to traverse around the map, effortlessly climbing and jumping from roof to roof. The current map is an Old Town (Staré Město pražské), which is a quite accurately recreated part of the Prague, Czechia. I am not aware whether there will be more maps in the future or not. The game has NPCs who are situated in the church which serves a purpose of a player hub of some sort. As I mentioned before, this BR doesn't have any new features that weren't used before in other BRs, except probably the ability to self-regenerate after being downed if you manage to survive for about 20 seconds. Gunplay is ok, nothing really stands out. Occasionaly you can choose to feed on citizens and even gain boosts to your skills if a human of certain personality type is consumed. You can also costumize your characters' appearance.  The negative thing is obviously the fact that the game is in early access and there seem to be quite a lot of cheaters, which devs seem to be highly motivated to eradicate in near future. Game is poorly optimized so far. Runs a bit poorly on my PC which is quite decent. And lately I've been having some weird bug with textures that are failing to load and you basically can't move on those parts of the map (your character is constantly in a flying position and you can't climb buildings in those parts). This texture bug is quite annoying and is the reason why I have decided to stop playing until it is fixed. Nonetheless, I am giving the game a positive rating and I highly recommend trying this game out or at least follow its further development.

_childDocuments_.review: tl;dr - Honestly can't tell you if the skill base of players is high or if cheating is just rampant... Either way, this game is not approachable for new players at this time (7/26/22)Long story:I am a VTM fan, not a Fortnite fan; so everything below should be viewed with that filter.Hard to rate since this is a PVP styled game with a lot of highly skilled or hacking players... difficult to even complete the "main story" quests as a lot of quest steps include visiting locations in the PVP arena map which are oftentimes guarded by players waiting for new players trying to complete the quests. After the 5th round of getting instantly killed while attempting to reach a quest target, I closed the game and honestly don't know if I will bother going back.VTM contains the motif of "dark beauty" which is not realized in Bloodhunt. The character models look... well... ugly. Even with cash shop clothes, tattoos, piercings, etc - VTM really deserves a full blown character creator similar to that found in Saints Row. The music isn't anything memorable, but doesn't really take anything away from the gameplay either. KB/Mouse here. Dunno if there's an auto-aim feature for gamepad users that might be why I felt like everyone was operating with aimbot, or maybe my aiming has gotten worse as I've gotten older. Everything is simple 3rd person over the shoulder control with jumping, crouching, and some awkward sliding. I didn't feel like there was much usefulness in stealth here, though maybe I was just ignorant of opportunity. If there are any other players out there like me - then they are hungry for Bloodlines 2 and they were hoping that running around as a vampire in a battle royale environment would satisfy the desire for another RPG epic. This really doesn't do it. It kinda tries - with the quests, and the development of the story ... and the inclusion of archetype levels... but the player base of real people does not replace the social element(s) involved in a real Masquerade game. If someone is sitting down and wants to play a Masquerade game and plays Bloodhunt... I think that's the rough equivalent of expecting Dungeons and Dragons from an arcade game of Gauntlet: Legends. Some of the elements are there, and it'll kill some time, but it won't really scratch the itch.

However there is a lot of bugs but the game is early access so hopefully developers will rectify these issues with time.Pros:Fun to play - Solo/GroupedEasy to play once running smoothVariety of different weapons availableCustomisation of each individual character typeRelatively fast search times between gamesMost of all its free-to-playDoes have the option for a 1st Season battle pass which is good value and you get a lot of good rewards Cons:At the moment it can be very unstable if you have outdated components - freeze, crash, take ages to load etc..95% of the games I've played have been good but there is a possibility of a few hackers here and thereThe store prices are pretty crazy for such basic items Do seem to find a lot of higher tiered items always bunched up together, would be better spread across the map better IMOThere isn't and in-game report button feature In-Addition there isn't and option to add team mates whilst in game (unless you remember there ID Tag)Not much communication from Random teammates in groups so better to play with friends

_childDocuments_.review: I want to preface this by saying this game has a unique style and awesome potential. BUT IT IS VERY VERY VERY broken and unbalance at the moment. Needs a lot of work. Found myself getting stuck in long/never-ending matchmaking times, glitched seemingly empty servers, my friend getting stuck, as well as some unbalanced issues during combat. The UI could be a little easier to see. It's a little out of the way in my blind spot almost. I don't really know what's going on most of the time even with my own actions. There is also another issue of some slow/latency play. I dont know how to describe it, other than sluggish gameplay.There is not really a way (that I know of) to identify other player(s) roles in the world. You just kind of know what they are using after you are already hit with it or if you can even tell what is going on. You're really only able to identify your own squad's abilities. When you start fighting another group, there is no telling how to fight them until you are already dead, or they are dead. It's almost bland in a way like that, because the combat is "seemingly" the same stuff over and over, no matter the opponent. (that being point and shoot and jump and shoot)Lastly, I recommend finding a way to make the game easier for new players (either to the game or new to PC) to understand the fundamentals more. There is a tutorial that starts up right away, but it only covers so much. But if there is a new player to BR games in general, PC in general, or games overall; there really isn't a way for them to get associated with things very easily here. It's just "load into hub, press F1, find session that wont break, try to murder where you can, get killed by unbalanced teams or guns, repeat." Other than that, there isnt much incentive to WANT to progress, other than a little cosmetics here and there (if any).There is a lot more I could go into, but like I said, this game is GREAT! It deserves more attention, but it also needs some attention on the issues it has. It is almost unplayable at times. Hopefully I can play again in the future without the grand majority of the game trying to reconnect or find a session that isn't broken.

_childDocuments_.review: This game has potential to be good however there are a few things I should mention that make it not great at this time. Yes, it's early access so it has time to grow and will change my tune (maybe) if things get better.1) Matchmaking times - I've never really seen a battle royale take so long for matchmaking. It's fine sometimes but other times takes 10 or more minutes. 2) Bugs w/ Group - Sometimes it autofills, sometimes it doesn't. If you have a group it will potentially not even load you into the game but load your teammates in and keep you in the lobby area. 3) Lag - There were times it got a bit lag-ish and you'd teleport back a few steps. 4) Something I've personally not liked about a few battle royales is the autofill feature. If I wanna play with just one other friend I don't much care for being forced to play with another person. There were a few other bad points not worth noting (right now) but you get the point. Aside from that the best things thus far are the animations & graphics but not much of a game with just that.

_childDocuments_.review: As the months churn on, I am starting to love this game more and more. I decided to change my review two times now as it has been a roller coaster ride of emotions. It has a few bugs, I will not lie that can be game breaking sometimes. But at this point, what game hasn't?However, the dev team are working on resolving the bugs as I re-write this review and that is something that is to be commendable. Now as for the game itself, there is not other game out there like this. It is fast, brutally vertical, and  you really have to keep your head in the game at all times as it is easy to be located, stalked, or just outright be bull rushed by anyone due to the sense mechanic.I would say, give it a go. It is free to play and I can only recommend it if you want a challenging little battle royale game set in a dark, quite grim reality.

_childDocuments_.review: Cheating is killing the player base, not matchmaking time. My friends refuse to come back until they do something to mitigate some of the cheating ruining their experience (fps is their favorite genre and they've been playing it well over 5 years). I enjoy playing this game because I'm working on improving my fps skills in general (this is my first ever fps). BUT my friends  are way better than I am and get frustrated with the excessive cheating, even though one said it was his all-time favorite fps now. The developer hasn't made any note of this problem on their website. WE'RE PRETTY SURE THEY HAVE AN AGREEMENT WITH ANTI-CHEAT NOT TO TALK ABOUT THE PROBLEM. (I can't find the word "cheat" anywhere. At all. On their updates etc.) But they could do something like make a separate matchmaking group based on level (50 and above) or a certain amount spent in the shop (like $10-20, something low). Otherwise, just make a new account and start over, there's nothing lost. We've *seen* cheaters get banned then just pop up with a new screen name five or ten minutes later with an extra letter in their name. We've gone into trios with two (when duo wasn't available) and got aim bot cheaters as our third team mate over FIVE TIMES IN A ROW (confirmed through observing them before leaving). We'd look up who killed us on tracker.gg and they'd have close to 40% accuracy and something like a 50% win rate constantly, not to mention alternate accounts with extra numbers or letters. I've been paired with so many level one's this week with default skins and icons, I rejoice when I meet someone over level 20. "We hear you, we're working on the bugs! Bugs, bugs, bugs!" say the developers, but there isn't a word about the elephant in the room that is actually killing their player base steadily. Not. A. Word. I'm a huge Vampire The Masquerade LARP fan, played for several years in a national organization. I was so excited for this and I even got my friends into the lore as we played and had fun. I regret getting into this game because now it's just me trying to get better at playing by myself, waiting for my friends to come back, and regretting the money I may have wasted on a game I had high hopes for that's been dying from day one...

_childDocuments_.review: Been a long time fan of the series ever since my cousin introduced me to Bloodlines back on his PC in 2007. So to find out that a BR was in the making for this fantastic series I had to jump in on it.To kick things off, yes there was(and still) bugs that i've encountered in the game as it is early access so i dont expect it to be completely perfect from the get-go but they're nothing to serious or game breaking to go ahead and stop me from playing. If anything i rarely came across issues from my matches besides some stuttering or frame drops here and there.The gameplay itself is fantastic and gets you into the world of the masquerade, letting you FEEL the power and status of a vampire. So far there's only four clans; each containing two classes(with the exception of the Ventrue as they were recently released so we will have to wait for a second class to be released in the near future for them) that feels unique and different from each other and fits their respective characteristics in the lore. Like Apex, no class is necessarily bad but its obvious that some will be able to perform certain things better than others but you choose whatever clan class that fits your playstyle.Movement in this game is probably one of the best experiences i've ever witness in a BR and that says alot as Apex(in my opinion to say the least)would be the BR with the best movement hands down. From scaling up the walls to leaping great distances to even sending out your projection for short range teleports, the potential outplays with the movement alone is limitless!I am hoping Sharkmob adds the Mangrel, Tremere and Malkavian clans into the game to continue spicing up the variety of playstyles. If you are hesitant on the game, dont be! Highly recommend giving the game a try plus it's free!!

_childDocuments_.review: Honestly my feelings for this game are very mixed. It is a fun game to play, but there are many problems with it. The biggest down fall would have to be the aim assist for ps5 players. Don't get me wrong, I don't mind them having aim assist. In this game, it's more like an aim bot though. If you're lucky enough to not get downed in two seconds by a ps5 player, then you most likely have mostly bots in your game. Bots will shoot at you before you even peak them, or they'll run around using their abilities, taking one or two shots at you, and then running away. Another thing that bothers me personally is how the map closes off. More often then not it's two open areas on either side of the map and a long thing stretch in between them. I feel like it would be more fun if it closed closer together and didn't have those long runs to the other side of the map. This would probably help promote faster fighting towards the end of a match as well. Lastly I've noticed the game goes differently for solo players vs if you're in a duo or trio. I understand you have more than one life as a solo vs having only one when in a duo/trio (not counting if they bring you back). What I don't understand is the different map card thingys, that cause the round to have no ai guards, everywhere is high tier loot area, gas spreads faster, etc. Feel like adding this to duo/trios would help the game be more interesting.There are more things that would make this game better, like fixing the often rubber banding, fixing the quest glitches, fixing the outfits/emote bugs, having an option to turn crossplay off, etc. But even with all of that said, I've still spent 68 hours on this game. The abilities are fun, and the different weapon combinations are too. Honestly not sure how much longer I will be playing, but it's free so try it out and see for yourself if you enjoy it and can put up with all of it's downfalls.

Sometimes you cant help but kill a civilian if a player is feeding on them whilst you are trying to kill them. PLEASE CHANGE THIS. _childDocuments_.review: Bloodhunt is the BEST Battle Royale game out there!It offers high vertical mobility which allows parkour to escape/engage!Beside the as usual good gun play, Bloodhunt offers a viable melee option for combat!Customization is nice and classes are decently balanced with the usual outliers.Full translation in 11+ languages is appreciated, not many games do that!The Battle Royale genre lost its 2010 popularity and the hype is dead.PUBG/Fortnite, they all are the same. Huge maps, much downtime.Why exactly are they better than short map, fast-paced FPS like Counter-Strike that are rich in action?The only BR that offer something unique are:SPELLBREAK and BLOODHUNT. (both of which are dying.)Bloodhunt had one of the worst launches, the game was riddled with bugs and cheaters, which killed the hype.The anti-cheat update launched after a whole month, by then the reputation of the game was ruined.The worst thing was that it took Sharkmob ages to fix the bugs. For a multiplayer Battle Royale this is critical.Nowadays, the game runs fine, no bugs or cheaters at all.But by then the player-base was irreparably damaged.For 1 whole year they held on, but recently announced the end of development for Bloodhunt...The game servers would be basically kept on life-support, but we all know that means the DEATH of the game...What a shame, the VtM franchise is so vast and Bloodhunt could have become the best Battle Royale game and worthy VtM successor to Bloodlines but alas.Just imagine,Lasombra vampires that control shadows and Tzimisce vamps that use fleshbending to turn opponents into furniture lol.Malkavians spreading confusion and insanity while Gangrel turn into beasts.So much potential that we will never experience...All we got were the basic "boring" clans:Ventrue (posh nobles),Toreador (Twilight books),Brujah (Lost Boys movie),Nosferatu (self-explanatory).The recent addition of the AMAZING Tremere (blood mages) is exactly my point of what else we will never see.So play this game while you still can.Experience the superb mobility and unique city of Prague!The player-base is small, but still plenty to find games within 1-3 minutes.

_childDocuments_.review: Just to be clear, since Steam won't let us non-curators mark a review as "Informational": My recommendation of this game is with a large amount of caution. Not due to the Anticheat controversy, as I am realistically not the most knowledgeable on the topic and have seen more evidence point towards it just being another Battleye. Not due to it being a BR set in a well-established and well-loved universe that may not be the most faithful to the world, either. My caution comes from the fact that it is poorly optimized and bug-ridden. I absolutely love the way the game is set up, being moreso a hero shooter where proper use of the mobility and planning are more important than simply "Finding the best gear" and camping with it; but the game is really held back by a plethora of issues with several of them being outright game-breaking. The devs do seem to be relatively responsive and have been quick to fix a few major things, but they have a long road ahead of them if they want to make it a truly stand-out title. I do really enjoy the game for what it is, don't get me wrong. At its best: It's a thrilling experience where you can create truly memorable moments that you won't find in other games. Once you learn the game, you have the freedom to make plays that truly give you the thrill of the hunt that you'd want in a game like this.It's just... Those moments are held back by plenty of instances of game instability and things just not working at times. Instead of rambling on further, I'd just like to leave a bit of a checklist of the worst bugs I've found in case the devs read reviews.1. The loading bug. Sometimes, for some unknown reason: I find myself stuck in the loading screen after the match has started. In solo: this pretty much just always ends with me dying with nothing I can do about it. In squads: it generally leads to me dying, just to find a playdough wonderland when it eventually moves me to the spectator view. And if I get rez'd: All of the mobility breaks, and I'm left "Floating" on the floor, with none of the physics working properly.2. The Slide/Run glitch. Sometimes, if I start sliding and stop doing so quickly: It causes me to go into a weird and laggy animation where I can't stop this Slide/Run hybrid for a few seconds.3. An infinite loading bug. Self-explanatory.4. Matchmaking breaking. Every now and then: It seems as though matchmaking breaks and I have to remake the lobby. The queue times are normally quick, so it's not hard to tell that it's not working when me and my friends are waiting there 3-5 minutes.Anyway, that is all. Solid mechanics that just need a bit of ironing out, a fun theme that allows them a bit of creativity in how they handle things, just incredibly rough atm. Oh, also: Please nerf the Prowler, Devs. The class is way too oppressive with little counterplay, especially with his unique ability. I don't mind his passive how it is now, but definitely tone down their main ability. My advice: Have the bats show the actual radius and not have it mark people for several seconds after leaving it. Or, if you don't like the last idea: give better warning to players that the bat swarm is coming. It's hard not to feel cheated when you die to someone effectively giving their team wallhacks that last just a bit too long. On that note: Maybe consider giving the ability itself a short duration. Mix and match ideas, ofc. I'm not asking you to gut the character, just that I'd like him to not feel as a "Must-pick" in teams.

_childDocuments_.review: == EDIT ==First update released and... wow. Sharkmob is going to be a case study in wildly successful games that cratered under an ill equipped dev team. Maybe one day this game will be good, assuming they have funding long enough to keep it running while they slowly update game breaking bugs.==/EDIT==This is one of the few BRs I've really enjoyed since early the days of Fortnite, pre-spam building and vehicles. Unfortunately the developers have shown a complete disdain for their user base. Laggy play, reload bugs, a free to play with broken report functionality. This game is full of cheaters, you'll see them as the toxic kids spamming "there are no cheaters, git gud" in the discussions and discord. Devs only seem to ban anyone who calls them out on their support responses.The good:This game has a lot of vertical play which is fun. The guns are simplistic and easy to understand and the abilities are decent.The bad:Cheaters, trolls, crossplay can't be disabled. The community has all but abandoned the game, leaving only the streamers, grinders, and cheaters. 4 / 5 games have someone aimbotting or a team sprinting at you with walls and two shotting you across the map.This is the biggest reason I will not be recommending this game is the development team. They have shown they don't have the capacity or the skills required to maintain a BR. Rather than fix reporting functionality, reload bugs, or allowing the disabling of crossplay, they instead buff aim assist and spend all their time streaming the game on twitch or bot replying in discussions.Advice to the devs: Canned responses to cheating that ask players to ignore your broken in game reporting feature in favor of a web form paints a clear picture of your priorities. It gives the impression that not only do you not care but you have no interest in connecting with your player base. Stop banning people who call out cheating and focus on the toxic people sending hateful messages in discussions/discord.
